name: select
description: A native select element with consistent field styling and a decorative chevron.

files.content: --- /** * OpenUI Select — framework-native, zero runtime dependencies. * * Plain JavaScript frontmatter (no `lang="ts"`) so the same source installs * into TypeScript and JavaScript Astro projects. Types live in JSDoc. * * @typedef {Object} SelectProps * @property {boolean} [invalid] * @property {string} [class] */ const { invalid = false, class: className = "", ...rest } = Astro.props; const BASE_CLASSES = "flex h-10 w-full appearance-none rounded-md border bg-white py-2 pr-9 pl-3 text-sm text-zinc-900 shadow-sm transition-colors focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-zinc-400 focus-visible:ring-offset-2 disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-50 dark:bg-zinc-950 dark:text-zinc-50 dark:focus-visible:ring-zinc-600 dark:focus-visible:ring-offset-zinc-950"; const classes = [ BASE_CLASSES, invalid ? "border-red-500 dark:border-red-400" : "border-zinc-300 dark:border-zinc-700", className, ] .filter(Boolean) .join(" "); ---
